english: Record the date, crop, bed and actual harvest weight. Write how much was used, kept, shared or lost. These records help you check the next plan.
Fruit, eggs, honey and other production
Use the unit you actually measured

Write the food and its source: tree, coop, hive or bed. Use kg for weighed food, eggs for counted eggs, or jars, bunches or items. Record jar size in the source column. Keep all amounts on one row in the same unit.
